# DS Style reference material

Where each file here came from. Everything was built or fetched in a container, never on the host.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `source-notes.md` | Read from [FrankieT19/rg-sp-ds-style](https://github.com/FrankieT19/rg-sp-ds-style) at `2847683`, with every value cited into that commit |
| `strings.txt` | `source/locale.json`, all eight languages, generated by `extract-assets.py` |
| `render/*.png` | Frames drawn by the launcher itself: built in `gcc:14` and run with `--preview --demo --render`, one per line of `stills.txt`, against the ROM tree in `fixture.txt` |
| `stills.txt` | The stills, and the buttons that pose each one, in the launcher's own event letters |
| `fixture.txt` | The sample library as file names; the GBA games are the source's own demo list (`source/dsstyle.c:594`) |

## Scripts

| Script | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `render-reference.sh` | Builds the launcher and renders `render/` from `stills.txt` and `fixture.txt` |
| `extract-assets.py` | Prepares the port's images with the launcher's hard alpha edge and black colour key, pre-scales the art with its sampling, rebuilds the 8x12 font as a TTF, and generates `strings.ts` and `strings.txt` |

Their headers give the exact commands. Rerunning `render-reference.sh` reproduces every frame but
`snake`, whose food the launcher seeds from the clock; the committed copy is kept, and the parity
check masks the food.
